integrity: Original parabolic-flow Example 5.9 is explicitly credited. Its qualitative Cesaro convergence and classical Wasserstein duality are not claimed as new. Formula and constants are supported by a self-contained analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the geodesic circle and exactly the symmetric speed \((1-\cos\theta)^\gamma\) for \(\gamma\ge1/2\); no stronger-norm or robustness assertion; possible unlocated general occupation-measure statement.
